responsibility: Header defining lightweight predicate objects used to parameterize RTL SSA scans and analyses by selectively ignoring parts of the IR. It provides the default ignore_nothing policy plus predicates that skip one specific instruction or all instructions covered by a set of insn_change records, via should_ignore_def and should_ignore_insn hooks. These small policy classes are shared by access, movement, and change-related routines that need to query SSA state while treating in-flight edits as absent.
